title: Renewal Plan Fee Amount and Billing Period — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**Clause 1 — Monthly billing.** On monthly billing the renewal plan fee of a Pocketwire Personal Account is booked on the renewal date as one plan fee entry whose billing period is the month in which the new period starts, and the renewal date then moves forward one calendar month, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist.

**Clause 2 — Annual billing.** On annual billing the renewal plan fee is the plan's annual plan fee, booked on the renewal date as one plan fee entry whose billing period is the year in which the new period starts, and the renewal date then moves forward one calendar year, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist. The annual plan fee is booked as it stands, rounded to the cent, with nothing taken off it.

**Clause 3 — Amount on monthly billing.** The renewal plan fee is the monthly plan fee of the plan for the new period, rounded to the cent (half up) once, at the end. The renewal discount percentage is the reduction percentages on the renewal plan fee added together into one total, taken off the monthly plan fee once and never one after another; a credit for the ending billing period is subtracted from that discounted fee after it; the result never falls below 0.00 before the single rounding. Every intermediate figure is kept unrounded.

### Renewal dates and billing periods (hypothetical dates)

| Renewal date | Billing | Billing period of the entry | Next renewal date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May | Monthly | May | 15 June |
| 31 March | Monthly | March | 30 April — there is no 31 April |
| 31 January | Monthly | January | The last day of February |
| 10 September | Annual | That year | 10 September of the next year |
| 29 February | Annual | That year | 28 February of the next year |

### Worked amounts (hypothetical figures)

| Monthly plan fee | Renewal discount percentage | Credit for the ending period | Renewal plan fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 12.00 |
| 13.99 | 25 | 0.00 | 13.99 less 25 percent gives 10.4925, rounded once to 10.49 |
| 20.00 | 15 | 3.40 | 20.00 less 15 percent gives 17.00; less 3.40 gives 13.60 |
| 20.00 | 25 | 0.00 | 25 percent acting once on 20.00 gives 15.00 |
| 4.99 | 10 | 6.00 | 4.491 less 6.00 would fall below 0.00, so 0.00 |
